description: Executes workflow action for a Sitecore item.

commandName.description: The name of the workflow command.

comments.description: The comment to be saved in the history table for the action.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

id.description: The ID of the item to have the workflow action executed. Supply this or path.

language.description: The language that will be used as source language.

path.description: The path of the item to have the workflow action executed. Supply this or id.

name: common-invoke-workflow
